items.title: Hide Tanaka interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, April 3, 2014
items.q: But I still remember the name of Kim.

ctx.x: And I asked so many people, and so many American people were kind of laughing. They know what happens even inside the embassy, the American Embassy people were kind of laughing. And some guy just came out and he didn’t even see me but he just “don’t give up, don’t give up. Anyway, you can do it yourself, just try it.” Anyway I came back to my hotel and I started calling the people and “can you borrow me the bass, just one day?” “No way.” And the next day I went back to the American Embassy with a bass. But even…
